summary: Telefônica Brasil S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting board minutes approving a declaration of interest on capital (IoC) of R$230 million gross (R$0.07197382114 per share, net R$0.05937840244) based on the May 31, 2026 balance sheet. The credit will be made to shareholders of record as of June 26, 2026, with payment by April 30, 2027, allocated toward the mandatory minimum dividend for FY2026. This is a routine capital return event, not a special situation.
